note: Huron NF campground on 58-acre Island Lake, a short drive north of Rose City on M-33 (Mio Ranger District): the lake is cold and clear, 25 ft deep, with a buoyed swimming beach and non-motorized boating from the day-use area; several sites see the lake through the trees. 1.25-mile loop trail with a spur to Loon Lake Day Use Area; the M-33 trailhead nearby reaches the Mack Lake ORV trails (no ORVs in the campground). --Claude
